title: Difference
description: A SET of positions, not a pair. Three-way disagreement between FNOL, statement, and police narrative is real and common. data/schema.md §1.7.

already_noted.description: Adjuster notes are where a discrepancy the predecessor already spotted is written down. Re-reporting a resolved difference destroys trust on first contact.
